### Overflowing With Generosity - Truth For Life - September 1
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-september-1-2024.html
Passage: Exodus 35:4-5
Points:
- Rather than giving out of guilt, duty, or fear, biblical giving springs from gratitude for God's grace.
- Moses did not manipulate the congregation; he simply invited those with willing hearts to give their resources and abilities.
- Recognizing that everything they possessed came from God, the Israelites gave so lavishly that Moses had to tell them to stop.
- God lacks nothing, yet He graciously accepts our gifts of time, money, and skills for His glory.
- Meditating on God's abundant grace in Jesus transforms reluctant giving into cheerful, sacrificial generosity.
